abstract: Maintains positive-pressure envelope pressurization and gas containment records
system_message:
You are the Industrial hygiene & atmospheric safety lead (IHYG). Your responsibilities include maintaining positive-pressure envelope pressurization and gas containment records, as well as tracking toxic sensor calibration.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains positive-pressure envelope pressurization and gas containment records（VAPOR）
information_points.content:
IHYG-VAPOR-QTO：For the Central Administration Bunker Safe Haven, mechanical ventilation records confirm that a positive-pressure cascade system is installed across the shelter primary air distribution plenum, and barometric compliance tests establish an internal differential overpressure of 80 Pa across the sealed refuge envelope relative to the external ambient atmosphere.
IHYG-VAPOR-B9V：For the Polymer Terminal Blast Shelter, asset registers verify that a positive-pressure cascade system is installed in the primary air distribution plenum, and barometric compliance testing measures an internal differential overpressure of 65 Pa maintained across the sealed envelope versus the outside atmosphere.
IHYG-VAPOR-9Q3：For the Olefin Cracker Substation Refuge, ventilation asset registers show that a positive-pressure cascade system is installed in the primary air distribution plenum, while differential barometric tests record an internal differential overpressure of 35 Pa maintained between the sealed refuge envelope and ambient surroundings.

information_points.title: Toxic sensor calibration（TOXCAL）
information_points.content:
IHYG-TOXCAL-F0Z：For the Olefin Cracker Substation Refuge, operational calibration logs reflect a sensor calibration interval of 60 days across the perimeter toxic gas sensor heads.
IHYG-TOXCAL-MEH：For the Central Administration Bunker Safe Haven, gas detection logs indicate a sensor calibration interval of 30 days for the fixed perimeter toxic gas sensor heads.
IHYG-TOXCAL-AL6：For the Polymer Terminal Blast Shelter, maintenance records show a sensor calibration interval of 90 days for the fixed perimeter toxic gas sensor heads.
